list: Section 1260H list of Chinese military companies (U.S. Department of War, formerly Department of Defense)
checkedBy: Max Glassman, against the Federal Register notice
howToSayIt: This page loaded a service from {company}, which the U.S. Department of War lists as a Chinese military company (Section 1260H list, June 2026). This is a government designation about the company. It does not show what happened to your data.
domainSource: Domains come from DuckDuckGo Tracker Radar's company mapping in shared/atlas.json, not from the government list. The list names companies, not websites.

companies.note: First added June 8, 2026. mediago.io is attributed to Baidu by Tracker Radar.

First added June 8, 2026. Alibaba sued to be removed (Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. v. U.S. Dep't of Defense, N.D. Cal. No. 5:26-cv-06227, filed June 23, 2026). As of the last docket entry we found (Aug 28, 2026) no ruling had removed it. Say 'Alibaba is contesting this in court' when flagging it.

notOnThisList.note: These companies are NOT on the Section 1260H list. Never say they are. They can still be flagged by country under the Commerce Department's foreign-adversary country list (15 CFR 7.4), which is a different list.
